fields.name: ModuleId
fields.evidence: esv::ai::combat::AiModifiersSystem::Update (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x17630E0) takes the singleton, compares its first 16 bytes with ls::Module::GetId(ModManager::GetActiveMod()) and, when they differ (or the lethality changed), reloads the AI modifiers of the load-ordered modules and copies the active module's Guid here. Live: one random-looking 16-byte value.

fields.name: AILethality
fields.evidence: Same function compares *(int*)(+0x10) with the value of eoc::ruleset::code::AILethality::GetValue and stores it with ls::FixedString::operator= after the reload. Live: a FixedString index.
